blurb: Guests go on fishing trips 15 to 22 miles into the Gulf of Mexico targeting snapper, grunts, tomtates, porgies, triggerfish, sharks (summer), and grouper. Experienced mates assist with baiting hooks, removing fish, and cleaning the catch. Trips are suitable for novice to experienced fishermen.
